rows.en:
Kagura ending (female).
Slot filler for male.
rows.notes: Developer placeholder under Alto's name plate (male branch of the female-only ending frd_kgr_010); translated literally, as c06489.

rows.en:
(I wonder if Kagura-kun's in the middle
of servicing his fighter...)

No, it's the result of
your own hard work, Kagura-kun.
Let's go!

(I'm going to see a movie
with Yuuto today!)

Oh, there you are at last,
\p.
Sorry, sorry, I'm a little late.
It's fine, don't worry about it.
Well then, let's go see it.

That movie was so absurd, I had no idea
what it was even trying to say...
Huh? You think so??

I thought it captured the unseen hatred
in people so succinctly. I was really moved.
...I-I guess you could read it that way...
No, no, that's definitely what it meant!

...Let's go into a shop and talk it over.
I want you to get it too!
O-okay, I get it, so stop pulling me!

(I'm going to see a movie
with Kagura-kun today.)
Sorry, I'm a little late.

That movie was way too absurd. I had no
idea what it was even trying to say...
...I-I guess you could read it that way...

(I'm going to see a movie
with Yuuto again today!)

\p.
Good timing.
We both got here right on time, huh.
So, shall we see a movie today too?
Let's hurry up and go!

That was a good movie.
It left a bad aftertaste, though...
A happy ending really is best, isn't it?

When it ends with the hero and heroine
splitting up, it's kind of sad, you know?
Mm-hm.
rows.notes: x21: player in many scenes, Ranka, Hoshimura; neutral listening reply.

rows.en:
Well, that was a long movie,
so I've gotten hungry.
Let's stop somewhere on the way home.

(I'm going to see a movie
with Kagura-kun again today.)
We both got here right on time!

That was a good movie.
It left a bad aftertaste, though...
Hmm, well...
rows.notes: x6: also before menu choices (scd_fes_804/805) and in frd_luk; fits all.

rows.en: (I'm going to Folmo with Yuuto today!)
Nah, I just got here too.
I see, that's good then.

We're shopping today, right?
Let's get going.
Man, you really saved me.
rows.notes: The player was the one shopping (Kagura found the item).

rows.en:
I thought we'd never find it, but talk about
missing what's right under your nose...
It was at the closest shop all along...
Sorry for making you walk all over.

Nah, don't worry about it.
I got to do some shopping too.
Okay, shall we head home?
rows.notes: x3: also the player in frd_luk_006; fits.

rows.en: (I'm going to Folmo with Kagura-kun today.)
I just got here too.
rows.notes: x7: female player in frd_luk/myk/rnk meeting scenes; fits.

rows.en: Sorry for making you walk so much...

(I'm supposed to hang out with Yuuto
at Folmo today...)

Sorry I'm late...
\p.
I got so tired of waiting.

I'm really sorry!
I was getting ready and ran late...

Ah, it's fine, it's fine...
Well, shall we look around a bit?
R-right.
rows.notes: x3: also the player in nml_mcl; neutral.

rows.en:
Maybe because it's a Zentradi town,
everything there was on a huge scale.

It sure was.
But it's comfortable. I like it.

Well then, shall we hang out
a little longer?
Yeah, let's do that.

(I'm supposed to hang out with Kagura-kun
at Folmo today...)

It's fine, it's fine, don't worry about it.
Well then, let's look around a bit.

It sure was.
But it's comfortable. I like it.
Yeah, let's do that.
(Today was a nice change of pace~)
